title: Inbound refund decoy on an unpaid bill — direction guard (AP)
narrative: AP direction test, previously inexpressible: the runner used to zero money_in for bill fixtures, so an opposite-direction line could not even be shown to the model. We owe Helsinki Office Supplies EUR 480.00 (this bill, unpaid). Separately the supplier refunded us EUR 480.00 for a prior returned order — an INBOUND (money_in) line, SAME amount, SAME vendor, one day off. An amount+vendor matcher is tempted; but a refund TO us cannot be the payment of a bill we still owe. GOLD: abstain — no line settles this bill. FAILURE TO CATCH: proposing the inbound refund as settlement (a false, wrong-direction match).
